mechanism: Checked inverse of App route identity and direct Observe source slot lookup

parameters.affinity: First CPU in actual allowed set; retain actual CPU and allowed set

workload.timed_entry: One complete synchronous App::poll with exactly one already-due ordinary NON notification
workload.fixture: Constrained-derived fixed server and separate fixed verifier client; blockwise disabled; 32-byte representation
workload.route_population: Every route slot occupied; target first or last
workload.untimed: Registration, signal, eligibility checks, previous notification consumption/authentication/content verification, virtual time advancement, deregistration and epoch recreation
workload.eligibility: No ingress, pending CON/retransmit, Q work, body ownership, deferred work or checkpoint work; exactly one eligible observer and one successful snapshot/send
workload.epoch_rule: Count calibration and warmups; assert now before actual mandatory-CON deadline; real deregistration/draining then recreate with distinct epoch keys; no shallow state or sequence reset

oracle.kind: Exact frozen direct poll wrapper, engine and Site scan copies; no function-pointer Site field
oracle.allowed_edits: Rename three copied declarations/calls and substitute exactly the due-notification Site call; preserve attributes except dual_io, bounds and bodies; verify inverse-renamed byte equality
oracle.limits: Nested shared candidate paths must be ineligible. Direct copying preserves static-call opportunities, not identical emitted code or inlining

timing.method: Criterion iter_batched_ref with PerIteration and a borrowed preallocated fixture
timing.boundary: PerIteration selects batch size one: setup before start; routine between start/end; input/output drops afterward; no Vec in this branch. Warmup elapsed includes setup
timing.limits: Per-iteration clock, black_box and borrow/dereference overhead are included symmetrically; never subtract calibration or nominal overhead

gates.correctness: All required nonignored tests and full-output/authentication/selection/refusal/recovery fixture comparisons pass before sampling
gates.fixture_order: Before any sample, run one baseline and one candidate fixture-only process; compare all eight deterministic full-wire/content receipts. Timing arms also retain and compare their fixed preludes
gates.fixture_identity: Identical deterministic fixtures may be replayed in isolated test processes; every ordinary epoch recreation inside a process uses distinct key material and normal deregistration/draining
gates.benefits: Both benefit metrics: candidate/baseline mean change <= -0.05 and normalized upper95 < 0 in both rounds
gates.guards: Every other metric: normalized candidate/baseline upper95 <= 0.02 in both rounds
gates.otherwise: Reject or inconclusive; no threshold relaxation, replacement cohort or selective omission

stopping: Any identity, fixture, cleanup, budget, setup-iteration or deadline failure stops later arms and remains retained. Setup corrections allowed only before any sample. After any sample no replacement or retry cohort
claims: Instrumented hosted complete-notification poll wall cost only. No CPU50, socket throughput, emitted frame, peak stack, whole-memory, replay-admission or physical-device claim
